about: Terms the translator gets with every request. keep: never translated. terms: product words with what they mean in this app (CONTEXT.md). Desktop translations of shared words are in desktop-terms.json.

terms.Connection Profile: A saved configuration for reaching one opencode server: address, username and password. It is not a user account. Translate as a saved server connection, consistently.
terms.server: The opencode server running on the user's computer that the phone connects to.
terms.session: One conversation with the coding agent. Use the desktop app's word.
terms.child session / subagent: A session started by another session's agent to do part of the work.
terms.archive: Hide a session from the list without deleting it; it can be unarchived.
terms.project: A code folder (git repository) on the server that the user added to the app.
terms.worktree: A git worktree: a second checkout of the same repository in another folder. Keep the git term (worktree) where the language's developers use it; it is not a 'workspace'.
terms.main checkout: The repository's primary folder, as opposed to its worktrees.
terms.agent: The AI coding agent (Build, Plan, or a custom one) that works in a session.
terms.model: The AI language model (Claude, GPT, …) an agent uses.
terms.variant: A model's reasoning effort setting, such as high or low.
terms.provider: The company or service that hosts models (Anthropic, OpenAI, …).
terms.permission request: The agent asking the user to allow an action, such as running a command. Answers: Allow once, Always allow, Reject.
terms.question request: The agent asking the user a question with options to pick.
terms.todo list: The agent's checklist of steps for the current session.
terms.tool: An action the agent runs: read a file, edit, run a shell command, search.
terms.shell: A command-line shell on the server. Keep 'shell' where developers in the language say it.
terms.diff / Change Set: The file changes a session made, shown as added and removed lines.
terms.compact: Summarize a session's earlier messages so it fits the model's context window.
terms.context: How much of the model's context window (its working memory) the session uses.
terms.steer / queue: Steer: send a message that reaches the agent while it is working. Queue: hold a message until the agent finishes.
terms.slash command: A command typed with a leading /, such as /compact. Keep the slash and the command name.
terms.pairing code: A one-time code from `opencode pair` that connects the phone to the server.
terms.App Lock: The app's own lock that asks for biometrics or the device passcode. Translate the name.
terms.Server Health: The screen that shows uptime, ping and reconnects for a server.
